subject: Weekend stress run — expedited credit top-up request
messages:
From: Alice Chan <alice.chan@brightcart.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekend stress run — expedited credit top-up request

Hi Vanessa,

Quick ask: BrightCart is planning a weekend stress run to validate latency at 60 qps p99+ for our recommendation engine. The run is scheduled for this Saturday 04/22 01:00–05:00 PDT (4 hours). We finished the integration and our sandbox consumed the initial trial allocation faster than expected.

Numbers: our simulated traffic will be ~216k token-equivalents total (roughly 54k tokens/hour). We need an expedited top-up to avoid a hard stop mid-run — ideally 150,000 inference credits (or equivalent token allocation) and a short trial-extension window until 04/28 to finish the soak tests and internal reporting.

If the run passes, BrightCart is prepared to convert to Redwood Dedicated starting next quarter; this POC is gating procurement. Can we get an approval (or an interim bridge) today? We can share the load plan and MAP if helpful.

Attaching the POC load plan (poc-load-plan.xlsx) and a brief test matrix.

Thanks — appreciate the help on short notice.

—
Alice Chan
Senior Product Manager, BrightCart
alice.chan@brightcart.com
ops@brightcart.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chan <alice.chan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekend stress run — expedited credit top-up request

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and the attachment.

Short answer: we can support an interim top-up to cover the weekend soak. I want to confirm a couple of quick items before I escalate for approval: 1) exact credit units (you said ~216k token-eq — do you want 150k or 200k top-up?), 2) which region will you run from (us-west vs us-east), and 3) will you use streaming vs non-stream generation (affects cost).

Proposed offer (expedite path):
- 150,000 inference credits added to your trial pool (one-time, non-recurring)
- Trial window extended to 2028-04-28T23:59 PDT
- We’ll provision a temporary throughput profile configured for 60 qps and a KV cache enabled for prefix caching during the run

I’m attaching our Mutual Action Plan (mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf) and the poc-load-plan.xlsx you shared with in-line notes. If you confirm region and the exact credit amount I’ll loop in Sales Ops and Finance for sign-off and request an expedited release.

If you want us to auto-scale for burst beyond 60 qps, note that’s a separate approval — call that out if needed.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Weekend stress run — expedited credit top-up request

Team — forwarding BrightCart's urgent ask (attached). Summary: they need enough credits to run a 4-hour 60 qps soak tomorrow morning (est. 216k token-eq). Proposal in-candidate: 150k inference credits + trial extension to 2028-04-28 (one-time). Region: us-west (they confirmed offline).

Business notes: BrightCart is in active procurement; POC success is high likelihood to convert to Dedicated next quarter — recommend approval as a conversion accelerator.

Priyom — can you check quota/psm marker and prep the MAP update? Marissa/Ben — can you please sign off on one-time credit grant (150k) and confirm any billing or promo constraints? I’d like to get final confirmation to Alice by 17:00 PDT today. I’ve attached the MAP with in-line notes and a snapshot of the proposed approval for Huddle.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, poc-load-plan.xlsx

—

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chan <alice.chan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekend stress run — expedited credit top-up request

Alice — thanks for the quick reply and confirming us-west + non-streaming generation.

Update: Approved. We’ve provisioned a one-time top-up of 150,000 inference credits to BrightCart’s trial pool and extended the trial window to 2028-04-28T23:59 PDT. The Credits should appear in your account within 30 minutes.

Operational notes:
- Throughput profile tuned for 60 qps with KV prefix caching enabled for the duration of the run.
- If you hit sustained bursts above 60 qps, we’ll throttle to maintain p99 SLA unless you request burst capacity (we can enable but that requires a second approval).
- We’ve attached a signed MAP snapshot (approval_snapshot.png) for your procurement team and included the HubSpot deal link for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BRG-4491

Next steps from you: confirm the exact test start/end timestamps and whether you want RW (read-write) vs read-only trace logging (RW will produce more logs and is billable). If everything looks good I’ll also send a short DocuSign to finalize the promo note.

Thanks — good luck with the run, and let me know if anything trips up.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0143
Redwood Inference
